card.name: Image display plane instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas right before anatomical imaging planes (transverse, sagittal, coronal) in PET or scan image display instructions.

modes.label: Before imaging planes
modes.description: Words like in, the, and, or a comma in a list leading up to transverse, sagittal and coronal planes.

modes.description: Linking words in advice about viewing or fusing with anatomic CT or MR images.
